verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The rewriting is only the unfolding of ‖·‖_k: Lean quantifies ∀ j ≤ q, ∀ i : Fin 5, ∀ X, ∀ eta ∈ S with a single constant C, which is exactly sup over the five components, over η-derivative orders 0..q and over X of |∂_η^j Δm_N| ≤ C/N — the paper's D_k with k = q. The second display is obtained from `Localized.profileHistory_difference`: with the two profile families sharing the axis value (hP0 : P.pressure0 = Q.pressure0 = Π_0(η)), the pressure row of profileHistory differs by exactly the pressure component of historyDifference, i.e. Π_N - Π_0^prof = ΔC_{p,N}, and the bound is then the i = historyIndex pressure instance of the jet bound. Lean uses one constant for all orders j ≤ q where the paper writes a constant D_k per order; taking C = D_q recovers the Lean form and conversely.
